sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.usage: Official objectives, three scopes, approximate areas and design tasks.
sources.limitations: The public page does not provide precise reusable polygons in this repository.

sources.title: 面向全球智能体开源征集任务书摘录
sources.usage: Six agent tasks, co-creation charter, minimum case/scenario/persona outputs and boundary clause.
sources.limitations: Not a statutory spatial control or government commitment.

sources.title: Shaping a Heat Resilient City — Digital Urban Climate Twin
sources.usage: Reference for coupling environmental models and testing heat-management options before adoption.
sources.limitations: Case mechanism only; climate, law, data and governance cannot be transferred directly.

sources.title: Responsible Sensing Lab
sources.usage: Reference for transparent, replicable public-space sensing and value-sensitive prototyping.
sources.limitations: Institutional self-description; no statutory or performance transfer.

sources.title: Array of Things
sources.publisher: University of Chicago / Argonne National Laboratory / City of Chicago
sources.usage: Reference for modular urban environmental sensing, open data, edge processing and oversight.
sources.limitations: The original node program changed after 2021; used as a documented mechanism, not a current deployment claim.

sources.title: National Buried Infrastructure Facility
sources.usage: Reference for controlled, near-full-scale research on soil–infrastructure interaction, sensing and trenchless technologies.
sources.limitations: Research-facility precedent only; no engineering feasibility transfer to Jing-Zhang.

sources.title: National Underground Asset Register
sources.usage: Reference for governed access to underground-asset data from many asset owners.
sources.limitations: Different legal and utility context; does not justify collecting or exposing Beijing utility data.

sources.title: Testbed Helsinki
sources.usage: Reference for real-city trials with companies, RDI actors, residents and city departments.
sources.limitations: Mechanism reference only; no performance or approval transfer.

sources.title: Mayor's Office of New Urban Mechanics
sources.usage: Reference for experiments that begin with communities and transfer ownership to operating departments.
sources.limitations: Civic-innovation practice, not a spatial or legal standard for Beijing.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法
sources.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会
sources.usage: Accessibility, connected facilities and user participation principles; Article 39 used only within its listed service contexts.
sources.limitations: No venue-specific compliance conclusion is inferred.

sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门
sources.usage: Public generative-AI service scope, transparency, data and complaint-channel boundaries where applicable.
sources.limitations: No service filing, security assessment or legal opinion is inferred.

sources.usage: Discloses a spatial uncertainty in the provisional package.
